name: EPIC 246489089
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 10.1 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,542 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.88 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,026 K at its surface.
